inputs.goal: harden the auth service; a bypass is any unauthenticated admin action

scope.surface: admin endpoint access controls, session management vulnerabilities, credential validation bypasses
scope.rules_of_engagement: prioritize testing for JWT token manipulation, CSRF protection gaps, and role-based access control misconfigurations

attack.bypass: admin endpoint accessible without valid JWT token
admin endpoint accessible without valid JWT token
admin endpoint access control bypass via JWT token manipulation
admin endpoint accessible without valid JWT token

defend.mitigation: Implemented JWT token expiration and signature verification, added CSRF tokens to all admin endpoints, enforced role-based access control checks on every admin action, introduced session timeout mechanisms, and validated all credentials against a strong password policy with multi-factor authentication requirements.
